Abbas Ke Kaleje Ko Thanda Kiye Beghair.

 Sajjad Shair Likhta Hoon Charba Kiye Beghair.

item.text:
Reconstructed all 17 verses in Urdu script and verified that they align with the Roman transcription in `romanLyrics`. Set the direction to right-to-left and removed the `noUrdu` tag.

I read the ambiguous Roman `Qayam` as `قائم` in the verse about Zulfiqar. Only the selected lyric was edited.
